effect.en: This unit can use **UNBIND** abilities as if it had **WIZARD (1)**.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase

declare.en: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **AUTO-ENDRIN** within this unit’s combat range and that is not in combat to be the target.

effect.en: Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if the target is a **SKYVESSEL**, you can remove this unit from the battlefield and set it up again on the battlefield wholly within 6" of the target and more than 9" from all enemy units.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

declare.en: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** wholly within 24" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase

declare.en: Pick a friendly **FLAGSHIP** wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en: For the rest of the phase, each time the target uses a **SHOOT** ability, you can re-roll 1 of the hit rolls made for that ability.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
•  This unit can immediately use a **SHOOT** ability as if it were your shooting phase but all of its attacks must target the target enemy unit.
•  For the rest of the phase, this unit’s **Privateer Heavy Weapons** have **Shoot in Combat**.

wargear.en:
• ***Each model in this unit is armed with a Privateer Pistol and Arkanaut Hand Weapon.***
• ***2/10 models can replace their Privateer Pistol with a Privateer Heavy Weapon (Aethermatic Volley Gun or Light Skyhook).***
• ***1/10 models can replace both their weapons with a Skypike.*** 
• ***The champion cannot replace their weapons.***

declare.en: If this unit is a **Nullifier Auto-Endrin** and is in combat with any enemy **MANIFESTATIONS**, pick each enemy **MANIFESTATION** in combat with it to be the targets.

effect.en: Make a **banishment roll** of 3D6 for each target. If the banishment roll equals or exceeds the **banishment value** on the **MANIFESTATION**’s warscroll, it is banished and removed from play. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield.

The following apply to this unit:

•  This unit has a maximum control score of ‘-’.
•  When this unit is destroyed or removed from the battlefield, it does not count as being destroyed for the purposes of other rules (such as scoring battle tactics).
•  This unit cannot be picked to be the target of or be affected by any non-**CORE** abilities used by other friendly units unless the ability specifies **AUTO-ENDRIN**.
•  Ignore this unit for the purposes of friendly and enemy battle tactics.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: If this unit is a **Grudgeblast Auto-Endrin** and is in combat, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.

effect.en: Roll a D3 for each target. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: If this unit is a **Stuncloud Auto-Endrin** and is in combat, pick each enemy unit in combat with it to be the targets.

effect.en: Roll a dice for each target. If the roll is equal to or lower than that target’s Health characteristic, subtract 10 from the control score of that target for the rest of the turn. Then, remove this unit from the battlefield.

wargear.en: ***This unit comprises 1 of the following: Nullifier Auto-Endrin, Stuncloud Auto-Endrin or Grudgeblast Auto-Endrin.***

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

declare.en: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

effect.en:
For the rest of the turn:

•  The target can use a **RETREAT** or **RUN** ability and still use **SHOOT** abilities later in the turn.
•  No mortal damage is inflicted on the target by **RETREAT** abilities.

declare.en: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a dice. On a 2+, **Heal (3)** the target.

units.notes_en: This **HERO** can join an eligible regiment as a *Guild Officer*.

declare.en: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** or **Zontari Endrin Dock** within this unit’s combat range to be the target.

effect.en: Make a field repairs roll of D6 for each model in this unit. For each 4-5, **Heal (1)** the target. For each 6, **Heal (2)** the target.

wargear.en:
• ***Each model in this unit is armed with a Rapid-fire Rivet Gun and Aethermatic Saw.***
• ***1/3 models can replace their weapons with an Aethermatic Volley Gun and Gun Butt.***
• ***1/3 models can replace their weapons with a Skyrigger Heavy Weapon (Grapnel Launcher, Skyhook or Drill Launcher) and Gun Butt.***
• ***The champion cannot replace their weapons.***

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.

effect.en: Roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.
When you use the ‘Transport Skyfarers’ ability for this unit, you can pick units in combat to be targets.
This unit can transport 1 friendly **KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY** unit with a model count of up to 5 (see Battle Traits).

declare.en: Pick an enemy unit that does not have **FLY** and that this unit passed across this phase to be the target.

effect.en: Roll 4 dice. For each 4+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase, Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit

effect.en:
If all of the attacks made for that **SHOOT** ability target the same enemy unit, after that **SHOOT** ability has been resolved, roll a dice and add the number of damage points allocated to the target by that **SHOOT** ability. If the roll is higher than the target’s Control characteristic, apply the following effect to the target based on the ammunition type picked:

***Shieldbreaker:*** Ward rolls cannot be made for the target until the start of your next turn.

***Thunderdrakk:*** That target has a maximum control score of 1 until the start of your next turn.

wargear.en:
• ***Each model in this unit is armed with an Aethershot Rifle and Gun Butt.***
• ***2/5 models can replace their Aethershot Rifle with an Aetheric Fumigator or Decksweeper.***
• ***2/5 models can replace their Aethershot Rifle with a Grundstok Mortar or Aethercannon.***
• ***The champion cannot replace their Aethershot Rifle.***

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase

effect.en:
Until the start of your next turn, if this unit has not charged in the same turn, the following cumulative effects apply depending on your **fury level**.

**1+ *Irked***: This unit’s **Aethermatic Saws** have **Crit (Auto-wound)**.
**4+ *Exasperated***: This unit has **WARD (5+)**.
**7 *Incensed***: Add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.

effect.en: If this unit used a **SHOOT** ability this phase, this unit can move D6". It cannot end that move in combat.
While this unit is wholly within 12" of any other friendly **Grundstok Gunhaulers**, it can use **SHOOT** abilities even if it used the ‘Run’ ability in the same turn.
This unit cannot transport any friendly units.

effect.en:
Roll a D3. On a 2+:

effect.en:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:

timing.en: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase

declare.en: Pick an objective within 9" of this unit to be the target.

effect.en:
Roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the following effects for the rest of the turn:

• Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly **SKYFARER** units that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.
• Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of melee weapons used by friendly **Vongrim Salvagers** and **Vongrim Harpoon Crew** units for attacks that target a unit that is contesting the target objective.

declare.en: Pick a friendly **AUTO-ENDRIN** or replacement **AUTO‑ENDRIN** that has been removed from the battlefield to be the target.

effect.en: Make a manufacturing roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if there is a friendly **Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit** or **Endrinmaster with Endrinharness** within 3" of this terrain feature. On a 4+, set up a replacement **AUTO-ENDRIN** on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and more than 3" from all enemy units.

declare.en: Pick a friendly **SKYVESSEL** within 3" of this terrain feature to be the target.

effect.en: Make a repair roll of D6. Add 1 to the roll if there is a friendly **Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit** or **Endrinmaster with Endrinharness** within 3" of this terrain feature. On a 4+, **Heal (3)** the target.

Set up a friendly **Nullifier Auto‑Endrin**, **Stuncloud Auto‑Endrin** and **Grudgeblast Auto‑Endrin** (see the Auto-Endrin warscroll) on the battlefield within friendly territory, wholly within 6" of this terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

Subtract 1 from **hit rolls** for attacks that target a unit that is behind or wholly on this terrain feature, unless that unit **charged** this turn or has the **FLY** keyword.
